title: Big Batch Freezer Dirty Martini
description: This big batch freezer recipe for dirty martini is perfect for entertaining.

steps.text: Pour 6 ounces of vodka from the bottle and set aside for another use.
To the reserved vodka in the bottle, add vermouth, water, and brine until it reaches the top of the bottle. Put the top on the bottle and invert bottle to incorporate the ingredients.
Place bottle in the freezer for at least 4 hours and up to 2 months.
To serve, pour desired amount into chilled glass and garnish with olives.

video.description: Shaken and not stirred, the best martini recipe comes straight from the freezer. In this video, Nicole shows you how to make her favorite dirty martini with this big batch freezer cocktail! Coming together in a vodka bottle, the olive brine and vermouth is added straight in before being shaken and frozen.
